The '''2019–20 Super League Greece''' was the 84th season of the [[Super League Greece|Super League]], the top [[Football in Greece|Greek professional league]] for association football clubs, since its establishment in 1959.

The season marks the first year that the league that included a '''Play-off Round''', whereby the top six teams at the conclusion of the regular season played each other exclusively to determine the league champion. The rest of the teams played each other in a '''Play-out Round''' to determine the relegation positions.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.epo.gr/Home.aspx?a_id=256|title=EPO - Hellenic Football Federation|website=epo.gr|accessdate=2020-10-05}}</ref>  

The season was suspended on 13 March 2020 due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]],<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.besoccer.com/new/greek-super-league-postpones-play-offs-until-further-notice-808572|title=Greek Super League postpones play-offs until further notice|website=besoccer.com|date=13 March 2020|archive-date=3 October 2020|access-date=17 September 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201003232926/https://www.besoccer.com/new/greek-super-league-postpones-play-offs-until-further-notice-808572|url-status=dead}}</ref> then resumed on 5 June 2020.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://greece.greekreporter.com/2020/05/27/greek-football-resumes-on-june-6/|title=Greek Football Resumes on June 6|website=greekreporter.com|date=27 May 2020}}</ref>

During the championship, the multi-ownership scandal broke out between [[PAOK FC|PAOK]] and [[Xanthi F.C.|Xanthi]]. The ESA (Professional Sports Committee) considered the case serious, which meant the automatic relegation of the two teams. The government brought an extraordinary amendment to the parliament under the pretext of splitting social cohesion. The amendment provided for the deduction of 5 to 10 points from those who violate the law on multi-ownership in Greek football by acquiring shares of another football club.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://m.naftemporiki.gr/story/1555269/psifistike-i-tropologia-pou-katargei-ton-upobibasmo-gia-poluidioktisia|title = Ψηφίστηκε η τροπολογία που καταργεί τον υποβιβασμό για πολυϊδιοκτησία ΠΑΕ| date=2 November 2022 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ertflix.gr/epg/channel/ept1-live|title = Ertflix}}</ref> On July 30, the [[Hellenic Football Federation|HFF]] removed article 30 that referred to multi-ownership cases, an act which, as it turned out, was intended to cover the acquisition of Xanthi by PAOK.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.efsyn.gr/athlitismos/podosfairo/231022_exafanismeno-arthro-30|title=Το «εξαφανισμένο» άρθρο 30|date=12 February 2020}}</ref> 

[[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won the championship for the 45th time. They also finished undefeated in the 26 games of the regular season of the league and remained undefeated in the first 7 games of the final phase of the playoffs, until losing the 8th game of the playoffs (0–1 to PAOK). They also achieved a record of the best defence in the regular season with just 9 goals conceded.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/article/aettetos-kai-me-duo-rekor-sten-amuna-o-olumpiakos/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200720185925/https://www.slgr.gr/el/article/aettetos-kai-me-duo-rekor-sten-amuna-o-olumpiakos/|archive-date=20 July 2020|title=Αήττητος και με δύο ρεκόρ στην άμυνα ο Ολυμπιακός!|date=3 March 2020}}</ref>

Xanthi were relegated to [[Super League Greece 2|Super League 2]] after play-off matches, while [[Panionios F.C.|Panionios]] were relegated to the [[Gamma Ethniki]], while the Super League 2 champion, [[PAS Giannina F.C.|PAS Giannina]] and play-off winner, [[Apollon Smyrnis F.C.|Apollon Smyrnis]] were promoted.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cnn.gr/sports/story/232461/apollon-smyrnis-xanthi-3-1-epistrofi-stin-super-league-gia-tin-elafra-taxiarxia|title=Απόλλων Σμύρνης - Ξάνθη 3-1: Επιστροφή στην Super League για την "Ελαφρά Ταξιαρχία"|date=29 August 2020|website=CNN.gr|lang=el}}</ref>

==Multi-ownership PAOK - Xanthi==
In December 2019, Olympiacos appealed to the Professional Sports Committee to clarify the relationship between PAOK and Xanthi after TV channel One (owned by [[Evangelos Marinakis|Marinakis]]) reported that the Cypriot company RfA that had acquired Xanthi's assets (stadium and training center) appeared to be "linked" to [[Ivan Savvidis|Ivan Savvidis']] nephew, Ioannis Kalpazidis. {{ref|a|a}}
<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.liberal.gr/epikairotita/idioktisiaki-shesi-iban-sabbidi-kai-me-tin-xanthi|title=Ιδιοκτησιακή σχέση Ιβάν Σαββίδη και με την Ξάνθη|date=3 March 2019|website=liberal.gr|trans-title=Ivan Savvidis also has a proprietary relationship with Xanthi}}</ref> The Professional Sports Committee accepted the evidence presented by Olympiacos and decided to recommend to the competent judicial body the revocation of both PAOK's and Xanthi's certificates of participation in the championship and, consequently, their exclusion from the championship. PCS referred the case to the sports judge and asked for the penalty of relegation.

The Deputy Sports Minister, Lefteris Avgenakis, commented negatively on the prospect of relegation.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.star.gr/eidiseis/politiki/488117/aygenakhs-den-ypobibazontai-istorikes-omades-xwris-tekmhriwsh|title=Αυγενάκης: Δεν υποβιβάζονται ιστορικές ομάδες χωρίς απόλυτη τεκμηρίωση|date=27 January 2020|website=star.gr|trans-title=Avgenakis: Historical teams are not relegated without absolute documentation}}</ref>

The management of PAOK and their supporters were outraged by the decision, accusing Avgenakis of methodically setting up the committee, while protests and negative statements were also made by related individuals and organisations.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.star.gr/eidiseis/politiki/488255/paok-xanthh-to-xroniko-ths-apofashs-ths-eea|title=Το χρονικό της κόντρας για Ξάνθη-ΠΑΟΚ που έκανε άνω-κάτω και την πολιτική|date=28 January 2020|website=star.gr|trans-title=The chronicle of the Xanthi-PAOK race that turned politics upside down|quote=The decision provoked a strong reaction from PAOK FC, which claimed that the Deputy Minister of Sports, Lefteris Avgenakis, replaced two members of the SCA two days before the hearing of the case, who voted for the relegation of PAOK and Xanthi and reiterated that the law sets an obstacle for relatives up to the third degree and not more distant ones, such as I. SYRIZA also denounced Avgenakis for replacing two members of the ERA today (28/1), claiming that he had deceived the relevant committee of the Parliament.=}}</ref> For instance, former player and president of PAOK, [[Theodoros Zagorakis]], who was MEP for [[New Democracy (Greece)|ND]] at the time, was expelled from the parliamentary Eurogroup when he threatened to become independent if the decisions of the PCS were accepted.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.voria.gr/article/diagrafi-zagoraki-apo-tin-evroomada-tis-nd-me-apofasi-mitsotaki|title=Διαγραφή Ζαγοράκη από την ευρωομάδα της ΝΔ με απόφαση Μητσοτάκη|date=28 January 2020|website=voria.gr|trans-title=Deletion of Zagorakis from the ND Eurogroup by Mitsotakis' decision}}</ref>

[[First Cabinet of Kyriakos Mitsotakis|The Greek government]], afraid of a generalised reaction and as PAOK fans had started a series of protests, submitted an amendment on 6 February 2020 in order to prevent the sports judge's ruling.<ref name="Fotopoulos"/> It changed the penalty for multiple ownership by abolishing relegation and imposing a deduction of 5 to 10 points. 
<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.star.gr/eidiseis/politiki/488245/katetethhke-h-tropologia-ths-kybernhshs-gia-paok-kai-xanthh|title=Αυτή είναι η τροπολογία της κυβέρνησης για ΠΑΟΚ και Ξάνθη|date=28 January 2020|website=star.gr|trans-title=This is the government's amendment for PAOK and Xanthi}}</ref>
The amendment was passed with 156 votes in favour, while the parties the [[PASOK – Movement for Change|Movement for Change]], [[Communist Party of Greece|KKE]], [[Greek Solution]] and [[MeRA25]] abstained from the vote in protest of the legislation, which was rushed through in order to serve certain interests.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.efsyn.gr/politiki/boyli/228914_me-156-psifoys-alla-aponta-ton-samara-perase-i-tropologia-aygenaki|title=Με 156 ψήφους, αλλά απόντα τον Σαμαρά, πέρασε η τροπολογία Αυγενάκη|date=29 January 2020|website=efsyn.gr|trans-title=With 156 votes, but with Samaras absent, the Avgenakis amendment passed}}</ref>

The disciplinary committee of the [[Hellenic Football Federation|HFF]] decided to punish PAOK and Xanthi by deducting 7 points from the former and 12 from the latter{{ref|b|b}}. 
<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.cnn.gr/sports/story/210038/poini-afairesis-epta-vathmon-ston-paok-kai-12-sti-xanthi-gia-polyidioktisia|title=Ποινή αφαίρεσης επτά βαθμών στον ΠΑΟΚ και 12 στη Ξάνθη για πολυιδιοκτησία|date=5 March 2020|website=cnn.gr|trans-title=Penalty of seven points to PAOK and 12 to Xanthi for multiple ownership}}</ref> 

However, both Olympiacos and PAOK appealed to [[Court of Arbitration for Sport|CAS]] against the decision of the HFF, with Olympiacos requesting the relegation of the latter<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tanea.gr/2020/04/28/sports/vomva-o-olympiakos-prosefyge-sto-cas-gia-paok-kai-ksanthi/|title=«Βόμβα»: Ο Ολυμπιακός προσέφυγε στο CAS για ΠΑΟΚ και Ξάνθη|date=28 April 2020|website=tanea.gr|trans-title="Bombshell": Olympiacos appealed to CAS for PAOK and Xanthi}}</ref> and PAOK seeking their acquittal<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.documentonews.gr/article/paok-katethese-thn-prosfygh-sto-cas-gia-thn-timwria-toy-apo-thn-epo/|title=ΠΑΟΚ: Κατέθεσε την προσφυγή στο CAS για την τιμωρία του από την ΕΠΟ|date=5 May 2020|website=documentonews.gr|archive-date=21 August 2024|trans-title=PAOK: File an appeal to CAS for the punishment by the HFF|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240821012201/https://www.documentonews.gr/article/paok-katethese-thn-prosfygh-sto-cas-gia-thn-timwria-toy-apo-thn-epo/|access-date=21 August 2024|url-status=dead }}</ref> After both appeals, CAS decided that the 7 points should be returned to PAOK and referred the case back to the Appeals Committee of the HFF with the footnote that it should decide on the merits of the case without being bound by the conclusion of the CSP.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.avgi.gr/athlitika/360608_epistrefontai-oi-7-bathmoi-ston-paok|title=Με απόφαση του Διεθνούς Αθλητικού Δικαστηρίου - Το CAS «άδειασε» τον Ολυμπιακό για το «δεσμευτικό της απόφασης» της ΕΕΑ|date=11 July 2020|website=avgi.gr|trans-title=By decision of the CAS "cleared" Olympiacos for the "binding nature of the decision" of the AC}}</ref>

Eventually, on 9 February 2021, PAOK were fully acquitted by a decision of the Appeals Committee of the HFF.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.naftemporiki.gr/sports/129087/athoos-gia-tin-polyidioktisia-me-xanthi-o-paok/|title=Αθώος για την πολυιδιοκτησία με Ξάνθη ο ΠΑΟΚ|date=9 February 2021|website=natemporiki.gr|trans-title=PAOK not guilty for the joint ownership with Xanthi}}</ref> For Xanthi, however, there was no change in the decision, as the team did not appeal to the CAS.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/to-eggrafo-toy-cas-gia-tin-apofasi-ta-dikastika-organa-tis-epo-ekanan-lathos.8955427.html|title=Το έγγραφο του CAS για την απόφαση: "Τα δικαστικά όργανα της ΕΠΟ έκαναν λάθος"|date=10 June 2020|website=sport24.gr|trans-title=The CAS document on the decision: 'The judicial bodies of the HFF made a mistake'}}</ref>

==Teams==
Fourteen teams competed in the league – the top twelve teams from the previous season, the previous season's play-off winner and one team promoted from the [[Football League Greece|Football League]]. The promoted team was [[Volos F.C.|Volos]]. They replaced [[PAS Giannina F.C.|PAS Giannina]], [[Levadiakos F.C.|Levadiakos]] (both teams relegated after eight seasons in the league) and [[Apollon Smyrnis F.C.|Apollon Smyrnis]] (relegated after two seasons in the top flight).

{{note|a|a}} According to the complaint, Ioannis Kalpazidis, the representative of the Cypriot company RfA, which bought the assets of Xanthis FC, is allegedly the nephew of Ivan Savvidis. The complainant added that this person, who worked as a waiter, paid 10 million euros for this purchase. Olympiacos also complained that members of the board of directors of FC Xanthi were also on the board of directors of the RfA.<ref name="Fotopoulos">{{cite thesis |last=Fotopoulos |first=Giorgos |date=6 September 2020 |title=Ποδοσφαιρικά σκάνδαλα και ΜΜΕ:το ζήτημα της πολυιδιοκτησίας της ΠΑΕ ΠΑΟΚ στον αθλητικό διαδικτυακό τύπο της Θεσσαλονίκης |url=https://apothesis.eap.gr/archive/item/6054?lang=el |degree=MSc thesis |publisher=Hellenic Open University |page=43 |trans-title=Football scandals and the media: the issue of the multi-ownership of PAOK FC in the sports online press of Thessaloniki.}}</ref>
